name: Settlement Patterns of the Peaceful Era

game.core.world.fact.summary: Most modern Thalorien settlements grow around dependable water, maintained roads, productive land, and a shared public heart such as a market square, shrine, hall, or inn. They are practical and welcoming rather than heavily militarized: walls and watch posts exist where danger requires them, but ordinary life is organized around work, neighbors, and seasonal gatherings.
